title: 7 AI Projects Engineering Students Can Build in 2026
description: Seven practical AI engineering capstone ideas with clear prototypes, tools, and evaluation metrics for senior design students in 2026.

pages.heading: 7 AI Projects You Can Actually Build in 2026
pages.text: Each solves a real engineering problem and gives you measurable results to defend.
pages.alt: Engineering students collaborating around AI, robotics, energy and safety prototypes in a university lab

pages.heading: 1. Predictive Maintenance
pages.text: Use vibration, temperature and current data to predict faults or remaining useful life. Measure MAE, F1-score and detection lead time.
pages.alt: Student attaching diagnostic sensors to an industrial electric motor for predictive maintenance

pages.heading: 2. Smart-Grid Fault Detection
pages.text: Forecast demand or locate grid faults with Python or MATLAB. Test RMSE, fault recall and response time under changing loads.
pages.alt: Student analyzing an AI-enabled renewable smart-grid model with a highlighted electrical fault path

pages.heading: 3. Autonomous Delivery Rover
pages.text: Combine ROS 2, lidar, a camera and obstacle avoidance. Track navigation success, collisions, localization error and travel time.
pages.alt: Student-built autonomous indoor rover using lidar and computer vision to navigate a university corridor

pages.heading: 4. AI PPE and Hazard Detection
pages.text: Detect hard hats, safety vests and restricted-zone entry with edge vision. Evaluate precision, recall, mAP and alert latency.
pages.alt: Edge camera system detecting hard hats and safety vests in a construction safety test area

pages.heading: 5. Battery Health Predictor
pages.text: Estimate state of health and remaining life from voltage, current, temperature and charge cycles. Report SOH MAE and RUL error.
pages.alt: Engineering student measuring an electric vehicle battery pack for AI-based health prediction

pages.heading: 6. Adaptive Traffic Signals
pages.text: Train a reinforcement-learning controller in SUMO. Compare it with fixed timing using queue length, waiting time and throughput.
pages.alt: AI-controlled city intersection with adaptive traffic signals and visualized vehicle routes

pages.heading: 7. Engineering RAG Assistant
pages.text: Build an assistant grounded in manuals and maintenance logs. Measure retrieval accuracy, citation accuracy, latency and hallucinations.
pages.alt: Engineering student connecting technical manuals to a machine through a retrieval-augmented AI system

pages.heading: Pick the Project You Can Prove
pages.text: Choose a real problem, a feasible prototype and metrics your team can measure. Complexity alone does not make a strong capstone.
pages.alt: Engineering team reviewing several AI capstone prototypes before selecting a testable project
